repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: roadmap.sh 是一个社区驱动的开发者成长平台，提供交互式技术路线图、学习指南和最佳实践资源，覆盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等 30+ 技术领域，支持按初学者/进阶路径定制学习路径，助力开发者系统化职业发展。
repos.summary_en: roadmap.sh is a community-driven platform offering interactive technology roadmaps, guides, and best practices for developers. It covers 30+ domains including Frontend, Backend, DevOps, AI, and Data Science, with beginner/advanced learning paths to support structured career growth in tech.

repos.description: AI 影视生产级工具 | 支持 Seedance 2.0 | 剧本到成片全流程批量化 | AI-powered film production tool with Seedance 2.0 support
repos.summary_zh: 魔因漫创是一款AI影视生产级工具，支持Seedance 2.0多模态生成，实现从剧本解析、角色场景生成到分镜制作与成片输出的全流程自动化。具备角色一致性管理、批量化生产队列、多供应商AI调度等核心能力，专为短剧、动漫番剧等中高频内容创作场景设计。
repos.summary_en: Moyin Creator is an AI-powered film production tool supporting Seedance 2.0 for end-to-end automation from script parsing to final video generation. It features character consistency, batch processing, and multi-provider AI scheduling, optimized for short-form dramas and anime series.

repos.description: 一个基于Python和Flask的Web应用，整合了多维度股票分析能力和人工智能辅助决策功能。系统通过AKShare获取股票数据，结合技术分析、基本面分析和资金面分析，为投资者提供全方位的投资决策支持。
repos.summary_zh: 基于Python/Flask和LangGraph的智能股票分析系统，整合AKShare多源数据与13个专业AI Agent（技术、基本面、资金流、情绪等），提供100分制综合评分及情景预测。支持联网搜索问答、Human-in-the-Loop风险审批、MCP工具接口，具备财经门户式可视化界面与实时全球市场监控。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered stock analysis web application built with Python/Flask and LangGraph, integrating multi-source data via AKShare and 13 specialized AI agents (technical, fundamental, capital flow, sentiment). Features 100-point scoring, scenario forecasting, web-searchable Q&A, human-in-the-loop risk approval, MCP tool server, and real-time global market monitoring with a financial portal-style interface.

repos.description: 这是一个基于AI的自动化交易程序，专为数字货币市场（BNB/USDT）设计。该程序旨在实现全自动化交易，通过AI算法帮助用户在数字货币市场中做出更智能的交易决策。
repos.summary_zh: GridBNB 是一个基于 Python 的企业级自动化交易程序，专为币安交易所设计，支持多币种并发网格交易。通过动态波动率分析、EWMA 混合算法和多层风险管理，实现稳定捕捉市场波动收益。提供 Docker 容器化部署、Nginx 反向代理、实时监控 Web 界面及理财功能集成，适合专业交易者进行自动化数字货币交易。
repos.summary_en: GridBNB is a Python-based enterprise-grade automated trading program designed for Binance exchange, supporting concurrent grid trading across multiple cryptocurrency pairs. It leverages dynamic volatility analysis, EWMA hybrid algorithms, and multi-layer risk management to capture market fluctuations profitably. Features include Docker deployment, Nginx proxy, real-time monitoring web UI, and integrated savings functionality for professional crypto trading automation.

repos.summary_zh: stock-open-api 是一个开源的股票数据接口库，提供从上海证券交易所和东方财富等公开数据源的股票信息查询功能，支持A股、港股、科创板、新三板及中国概念股等市场数据，适用于学习交流与量化研究场景，不可用于商业用途。
repos.summary_en: stock-open-api is an open-source library providing stock data interfaces from public sources like the Shanghai Stock Exchange and East Money, supporting queries for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, STAR Market, New Third Board, and US-listed Chinese companies, intended for educational and research use only.
